title: COVER YOUR DAY WITH THE BLOOD
text: Blessed be the Lord my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight. My goodness and my fortress, my high tower and my deliverer, my shield and he in whom I trust. Psalm 144:1-2. Before I greet you, before I welcome you, before I say good morning, I want to declare over your life that the God who trained David's hands for battle is training your hands this morning. You did not wake up by accident. You did not open your eyes by coincidence. The breath in your lungs is evidence that heaven still has business with you. And because heaven still has business with you, hell has no authority to close your chapter. I said hell has no authority to close your chapter. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Father, we bless your name. We honor you this morning, not because everything is perfect, not because every question has been answered, but because you are still God. In the middle of the uncertainty, you are still God. In the middle of the waiting, you are still God. In the middle of the warfare, you are still God. And we worship you not for what you have done. Though you have done mighty things, we worship you for who you are. You are Yahweh, the self-existing one, the uncreated creator. The one who needs nothing but deserves everything. We pour our worship on you this morning like Mary poured her alabaster on the feet of Jesus. Receive it, Lord. Let it be a fragrance in your nostrils. Hallelujah. Now, if you are hearing this message, I need you to do something before we go further. I need you to send this to someone right now, not after the prayer, not when you are done listening. Right now, because this message is not just for you. The spirit of God told me even as I was preparing that there is someone connected to your life who is one prayer away from breakthrough. They are one word away from deliverance, and you you are the carrier. You are the vessel God is using to deliver this word to them. Do not be selfish with what heaven has given you. Share it. Broadcast it. Let the fire spread. Now sit with me for a moment. I want to open a truth to you that will change the way you approach every single morning for the rest of your life. We talk about covering our day with the blood of Jesus. We say it casually. We say it as a religious phrase. We say it like a greeting. I cover myself with the blood. But most people who say it do not understand the weight of what they are invoking. They do not understand the legal transaction that takes place in the realm of the spirit when a believer consciously, deliberately and with understanding applies the blood of Jesus over their day. Let me take you to a scripture. Exodus chapter 12 verses 12 through 13. This is the night of the Passover. God is about to execute judgment on Egypt. Every firstborn is going to die. Every household will be visited by the destroyer. But God gives Moses a very specific instruction. He says, "Take a lamb. Kill it. Take the blood and put it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses." And then in verse 13, God says something that shook the foundations of the spirit world. He says, "And the blood shall be to you for a token upon your houses. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you when I smite the land of Egypt. When I see the blood, not when I see your tears, not when I see your fasting, not when I see your good works, not when I hear your eloquent prayers, when I see the blood." Do you understand what God is saying? The blood is not a religious symbol. The blood is a legal barrier. It is a spiritual boundary. It is a line drawn in the realm of the spirit that says to every destroying power, you cannot cross here. This territory is purchased, this life is redeemed, this household is under covenant protection. The price has been paid and the receipt is the blood. And here is the revelation I want you to catch this morning. The blood on the doorpost in Exodus did not only protect the people inside, it communicated to the destroyer outside. The blood was not speaking to the Israelites, the blood was speaking to the angel of death. It was saying this house is taken, move on, there is nothing for you here. When you cover your day with the blood of Jesus, you are not just performing a spiritual exercise, you are issuing a legal notice in the realm of the spirit. You are putting up a sign that every demon, every principality, every agent of darkness can read. And the sign says covered, sealed, untouchable. Listen carefully, there are dimensions to this. Hebrews chapter 9 verse 22 says without shedding of blood is no remission. And then in chapter 12 verse 24, the Bible says that the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Abel's blood cried out from the ground for vengeance. It cried out for judgment, it cried out for justice, but the blood of Jesus does not cry for vengeance against you. It cries for mercy, it cries for redemption, it cries for protection, it cries for covering. Every time you invoke the blood of Jesus, you are activating a voice that has been speaking in the courtroom of heaven since Calvary. And that voice is saying this one is mine. I paid the price, the debt is settled, the case is closed. This is why the enemy fights your morning. This is why the first thing that attacks you when you wake up is destruction, heaviness, laziness, discouragement, the spirit of slumber. The enemy knows, he knows that if you rise in the morning and consciously apply the blood of Jesus over your life, your family, your movement, your finances, your health, he loses jurisdiction over your day. His plans are annulled, his traps are neutralized, his agents are disarmed. So, he fights the morning, he fights your altar, he fights your first hour because he understands that a believer who covers their day with the blood is a believer he cannot touch. Revelation 12:11, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they loved not their lives unto the death. They overcame him." How? By the blood. The same blood that marked the doorpost in Egypt, the same blood that was sprinkled on the mercy seat in heaven, the same blood that Jesus shed on the cross. That blood is your weapon. That blood is your covering, that blood is your victory, and this morning we're going to apply it not casually, not religiously, with fire, with understanding, with apostolic authority. 1 Peter 1:18-19, "For as much as you know that you were not redeemed with corruptible things as silver and gold from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers, but with the precious blood of Christ as of a lamb without blemish and without spot. Precious blood, not ordinary blood, not the blood of goats and bulls, not the blood of sacrifice offered on pagan altars. This is the blood of the eternal son of God, blood that carries the DNA of deity. Blood that was shed willingly, not by force. Blood that is alive, not dried up, not expired, not weakened by time. Hebrews 10:19 says, we have boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus. That blood is still fresh. That blood is still potent. That blood is still speaking. And this morning, we are going to let it speak over every area of your life. I want you to stand. Wherever you are, I want you to stand. If you are driving, engage your spirit. If you are lying down, sit up. This is not a passive moment. This is a moment of activation. This is a moment of enforcement. >> [music] >> You are about to take your position as a blood-bought, spirit-filled child of the living God and enforce what Calvary has already accomplished. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before you this morning with a company of believers who are tired of being attacked. They are tired of waking up to battles they did not start. They are tired of the enemy encroaching on territory that belongs to them. And today, by the authority of your word and by the power of the blood of Jesus, we are drawing the line. Now, pray with me. Open your mouth and pray. I plead the blood of Jesus over my life this morning. I plead the blood over my spirit, my soul, and my body. From the crown of my head to the soles of my feet, I am covered. Every cell in my body covered. Every thought in my mind covered. Every word I will speak today covered. Every breath I will take covered. The blood of Jesus is my covering and I refuse to step into this day without it. I plead the blood of Jesus over my household, over my spouse, over my children, over my parents, over my siblings. Every member of my family, known and unknown, near and far, I draw the bloodline around them. No evil shall penetrate. No sickness shall enter. No accident shall occur. No tragedy shall befall. The blood is on the doorpost of my house and the destroyer must pass over. Pray it with fire. Shakandiri Mohle Barako Remashiko Basendri Lameba Shondalarikobe. Hallelujah. I plead the blood of Jesus over my going out and my coming in. Every road I will travel today, every vehicle I will enter, every building I will walk into, every room I will sit in, I cover it with the blood. I decree that no weapon formed against my movement shall prosper. Isaiah 54:17. No ambush on the road, no trap at the workplace, no setup in the marketplace. The angel of the Lord goes before me and the blood of Jesus seals every path. I plead the blood of Jesus over my finances, over every transaction I will make today, over every business deal, over every negotiation, over every account. I decree that the spirit of financial robbery is rebuked. The devourer is rebuked. Malachi 3:11. Every satanic siphon attached to my finances, I disconnect it by the blood. Money will not leak from my hands. Opportunities will not slip from my grasp. What God has assigned to me will find me. What heaven has released for me will reach me. No embargo, no blockage, no delay in the name of Jesus. I plead the blood of Jesus over my health. I speak to my body and I command every organ to function according to its original design. The body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. 1 Corinthians 6:19. And no disease has permission to inhabit the temple. I rebuke every infirmity. I command every sickness to dry up. I speak to blood pressure normalize. I speak to sugar levels normalize. I speak to hormonal imbalances be corrected. I speak to tumors dissolve. I speak to growths, die at the root. I speak to chronic pain, release your hold. The same spirit that raised Christ from the dead dwells in you, and he quickens your mortal body. Romans 8:11, be quickened, be healed, be restored. Someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord is showing me there is a pain in your lower back that has refused to leave. Doctors have given you exercises, they have given you medication, but it persists. The Lord says the root is not muscular, the root is spiritual. It was deposited through a dream encounter, and right now the fire of the Holy Ghost is entering your spine and burning out that deposit. [music] Place your hand on your back and receive it. The pain is leaving. It is leaving now. It is leaving in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Now I am going deeper. I'm going into warfare. I come against every altar that has been raised against anyone connected to this prayer. Listen to me. There are altars, literal spiritual altars, where names are mentioned, where incantations are chanted, where sacrifices are offered, and they are speaking against the destinies of God's people. Some of these altars were erected generations ago, some were erected last week, but all of them operate on the same principle. They receive sacrifice and they release affliction. But there is an altar that is higher. There is a sacrifice that is greater. Hebrews 13:10, we have an altar whereof they have no right to eat, which serve the tabernacle. Our altar is Calvary. Our sacrifice is Jesus. And the blood that was shed on that altar supersedes every other blood that has been shed on every other altar in the history of human existence. So I decree every evil altar speaking against your life, your family, your marriage, your finances, your ministry, I command it to catch fire now. Every priest ministering at that altar, I command confusion into their ranks. Every sacrifice that has been offered, I neutralize it by the blood of Jesus. The altar is overthrown, the covenant is broken. The hold is released. You are free. The blood has spoken and the verdict is irreversible. Every covenant that was made on your behalf without your knowledge, broken. Every dedication to any marine spirit, any ancestral spirit, any territorial deity, cancelled. Colossians 2:14, the handwriting of ordinances that was against you has been blotted out and nailed to the cross. It is finished. The blood has settled it. I break every curse operating in your bloodline. Every curse of premature death, every curse of failed marriages, every curse of mental illness, every curse of poverty, every curse of addiction. Every generational pattern that has been recycling itself, I command it to stop. Not one more generation. The cycle breaks here. It breaks now. It breaks at the foot of the cross where the blood is flowing. Rabashikaramosendrilebako. Shimandalareekobe. Kayamilosendribemasho. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I am praying now for those who are under spiritual surveillance. You know who you are. You feel watched. You feel monitored. Every time you are about to make progress, something happens. Every time a door is about to open, it slams shut. There is an intelligence network in the spirit world that has been tracking your movements, reporting your progress, and deploying agents to stop you. But Psalm 27:2 says, "When the wicked, even my enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell. I decree stumbling and falling upon every monitoring spirit. I blind the eyes of every surveillance demon. I confuse the signals of every witchcraft network that has been tracking your life. They will look for you and not find you. They will set traps for you and fall into them themselves. Psalm 35:8, let destruction come upon him unawares and let his net that he had hid catch himself. Into that very destruction let him fall. The tables are turning. The hunted is becoming the hunted. The oppressor is becoming the oppressed. By the blood of Jesus you are hidden. You are invisible to the forces of darkness. They cannot see you. They cannot reach you. They cannot touch you. I speak to marriages. I speak to homes. I speak to unions. Every power assigned to destroy what God has joined, I command you to bow. Every strange woman, every strange man, every spiritual spouse, every marine entity claiming ownership, the blood of Jesus revokes your claim. This marriage is a covenant. This home is an altar and the fire of God protects what the blood of God has purchased. For those who are single and believing God, the Lord says your season has not expired. His timing is not late. What is being prepared for you is worth the wait. And I decree that before the next 12 months are complete, there will be a development so significant that you will know it was God, not man, not manipulation. God, the divine orchestrator is arranging your story and the next chapter is about to unfold. I speak to the area of purpose and career. Some of you have been stagnant, not because you are lazy, not because you lack skill, but because there is a spiritual resistance against your forward motion. Daniel 10:12-13. The angel told Daniel that from the first day he prayed, his words were heard, but the prince of Persia withstood the angel for 21 days. There are princes, territorial spirits that resist the release of what God has spoken over your life. But the blood breaks through. The blood is your breakthrough weapon. When you apply the blood, reinforcements are released, Michael stands up, angels are dispatched, the resistance crumbles. And what was delayed is suddenly released in a flood. I decree that every spiritual blockage over your career, over your calling, over your business, it is dismantled now. The dam is broken. The flow has started, promotion is coming, visibility is coming, opportunities you did not apply for are coming, doors you did not knock on are opening, because when the blood speaks, everything that was locked must yield. Someone, the Lord is showing me you submitted a proposal, an application, something official, and you have heard nothing back. Weeks have gone by, maybe months. The Lord says, "Check again. By the end of this week, there will be a response, and the response is yes." And there is a businesswoman the Lord is showing me you've been operating at a certain level and you feel stuck, like there is a glass ceiling over your enterprise. The Lord says the ceiling is not glass, it is demonic, and I'm shattering it right now. Your next client is already on the way. Your next contract is already written. Expand your capacity because what is coming will overwhelm your current systems. Hallelujah. I plead the blood over the realm of your mind, because the mind is where the greatest battles are won and lost. Second Corinthians 10:4-5. The weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds, casting down imaginations and every high thing that exalted itself against the knowledge of God. I cast down every imagination, every fearful thought, every anxious projection, every depressive cycle, every suicidal whisper. The blood of Jesus covers your mind. Philippians 4:7, the peace of God which passes all understanding shall guide your heart and mind through Christ Jesus. I release that peace now. Not temporary relief, not momentary calm, permanent, abiding, settled peace that does not depend on circumstances. I decree over your children. I cover every child connected to anyone hearing this prayer. Psalm 127:3, children are a heritage of the Lord. And what belongs to the Lord, the enemy cannot claim. I cover them at school. I cover them on the streets. I cover them online. I cover their minds from perversion. I cover their bodies from predators. I cover their futures from destiny thieves. Every child named and unnamed in this moment, the blood of Jesus is their fortress. No evil influence will corrupt them. No wrong association will mislead them. No demonic assignment will succeed against them. Shikandala be Maroko Sendrila Rabashimo Kole Bakira Kayamandirilo Besento Maremo. Hallelujah. I am approaching the seal now and the spirit of God is intensifying something in my spirit. I hear the Lord saying, and this is for someone very specific. The season of barely surviving is over. You have been surviving. You have been managing. You have been scraping by. You have been holding on by a thread. But I'm transitioning you from survival to dominion, from endurance to authority, from hanging on to taking over. Genesis 1:28, God blessed them and said, "Be fruitful, multiply, replenish the earth, and subdue it, and have dominion." You were not created to merely survive. You were created to reign. Romans 5:17, "Those who receive abundance of grace and the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one of Jesus Christ." Reign, not beg, not power, reign. I decree that beginning today, the atmosphere over your life changes. The spiritual climate shifts. Where there has been winter, spring is breaking forth. Where there has been drought, rain is falling. Where there has been famine, harvest is erupting. Isaiah 43:19, "Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it?" Know it, recognize it, receive it. The new thing is here. I seal this prayer. I seal it with the blood of the lamb. I seal it with the name of Jesus. I seal it with the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every word spoken in this moment sealed. Every decree issued sealed. Every curse broken sealed. Every healing released sealed. Every door opened sealed. No power in heaven, on earth, or under the earth has the authority to reverse what has been sealed by the blood. Revelation 5:9, "You are worthy to take the scroll and open its seals, for you were slain and have redeemed us to God by your blood out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation." The blood qualifies us. The blood justifies us. The blood protects us. The blood promotes us. And the blood seals us. Walk into this day covered. Walk in protected. Walk in confident. Walk in knowing that the blood has gone ahead of you and prepared the way. Every enemy has been silenced. Every trap has been dismantled. Every gate has been opened. This is not just another day. This is a day marked by the blood. And what the blood has marked, no devil can erase. I decree you will not be a victim today. You will be a victor. You will not lose today. You will gain. You will not mourn today. You will celebrate. The Lord is on your side. Psalm 118:6, what can man do to you? The blood covers you. The blood shields you. The blood speaks for you. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in the fullness of everything Christ has purchased for you on the cross. This day is your testimony. This week is your breakthrough. This month is your evidence. It is finished. It is sealed. It is done. In the mighty, matchless, undefeatable name of Jesus Christ. Amen and amen and amen. Hallelujah.
